headline: Rest after yesterday’s long run
summary: Yesterday’s 22.03 km run and a short night point to recovery today. Rest from running; a gentle walk is optional.

recovery.label: Sleep
recovery.context: Garmin recorded a completed night; 3h 23m below its 8h 40m sleep need.

recovery.label: Sleeping HR
recovery.context: Prior 7-night average 63.1 bpm; prior 14-night average 64.0 bpm.

recovery.label: Resting HR
recovery.context: Three beats above Garmin’s seven-day average of 59 bpm.

recovery.label: HRV
recovery.context: Garmin reports balanced weekly status; overnight is below the weekly average.

recovery.label: Body Battery
recovery.context: Garmin estimates a 30-point increase during sleep.

recovery.label: Training Readiness
recovery.context: Recovery time 691 minutes (11h 31m) at 06:35; an estimate for demanding training.

yesterday.title: 22.03 km long run
yesterday.summary: 2h 41m 16s at 7:19/km; average HR 142 bpm. Garmin load 156, aerobic effect 3.7 and anaerobic effect 0.4.
yesterday.prescribed: 40–50 minutes easy, RPE 2–3, roughly 6–8 km; walking or rest if tired.
yesterday.completed: A 22.03 km run in 2h 41m 16s; no other activities recorded.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: Recorded duration and distance exceeded the prescribed limits. This describes the comparison, not intent or a judgment of effort.
adherence_evidence: The prior report capped the run at 50 minutes.
The run lasted 161 minutes and covered 22.03 km.
adherence_caveats: Perceived effort, pain and sensor source are not confirmed by the activity summary.

environment.humidity_dew_point_context: Reliable hourly city-level humidity and dew point were unavailable.
environment.heat_impact_interpretation: Heat is a plausible contributor to higher heart rate and slowing, but the device range does not prove conditions or cause.
environment.limitations: Device temperature is not a calibrated city weather observation; terrain and hydration effects cannot be isolated.

recommendation.title: Rest from running
details: Take the day off running and intense exercise.
If comfortable, walk gently for 20–30 minutes at RPE 1–2; prioritise sleep and normal food and fluids.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest if tired, sore or unwell; the walk is optional.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop activity for pain that changes gait, dizziness or illness; follow medical advice.

signals.label: Long-run load
signals.interpretation: A substantial session warrants recovery rather than extra mileage.

signals.label: Short sleep
signals.interpretation: A short night limits confidence in recovery.

signals.label: Recovery signals
signals.value: Body Battery 35 · HRV 32 vs weekly 44 ms
signals.interpretation: Low waking charge and lower overnight HRV support a rest day.

caveats: Device measurements are Garmin estimates; the recommendation is coaching judgment.
The 31 October report was generated before the run and is the basis for the adherence comparison.
Chest straps can improve HR reliability; this activity’s sensor source is unconfirmed.

run_assessments.assessment: 22.03 km in 2:41:16 (7:19/km), average HR 142 bpm, load 156, aerobic effect 3.7, anaerobic 0.4. Device temperature 22–30°C. Kilometres 5–10 averaged approximately 6:41/km and 144 bpm; kilometres 17–22 averaged 7:26/km and 152 bpm. Heat may have contributed to slowing and HR rise; route, pacing and other factors cannot be separated. Sensor source unconfirmed.
